A few questions about a weird card from a weird clan.

Bauble.

1. When a vamp becomes Baubleized it can't block etc. etc. but can it still
be rushed and worked over if so can it fight back ?
2. What happens to the Assalt Rifle or Flamethrower if the Vamp gets
splattered ?
3. Can the Baubleized vamp Deflect, Cloak other Vamps, Wake but not block -
to cycle cards or play any other reaction cards ?

Thanks in advance.

Rob T

PS. Has anyone actually made a half-decent deck using Bauble ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"shsoton" <shs...@dircon.co.uk> wrote:
> Bauble.
>
> 1. When a vamp becomes Baubleized it can't block etc. etc. but can
> it still be rushed and worked over if so can it fight back ?

Yes, since card text doesn't restrict either of those activities.

> 2. What happens to the Assalt Rifle or Flamethrower if the Vamp gets
> splattered ?

If the baubled vampire gets splattered? Nothing, since card text
doesn't offer any consequence for such activity, nor any requirement
that the baubled vampire remain ready or controlled or whatever.

> 3. Can the Baubleized vamp Deflect, Cloak other Vamps, Wake but not
> block - to cycle cards or play any other reaction cards ?

Yes, since card text doesn't restrict such activity.
